Bases: object

resolve(code: str, version: str = None, system: str = None, build_label: str = None) → Build | None[source]

Select the best matching build based on constraints. Ordering: 1. code (must match) 2. version (exact > wildcard/unspecified) 3. system (exact > unspecified) 4. build_label (exact > unspecified) 5. build_timestamp (newest first)
